title: Parameterized Chebyshev-polynomial univalence conjecture
statement:
Let $N$ be a positive integer, let $q\in\{1,\ldots,N\}$, and let $U_m$ denote the Chebyshev polynomial of the second kind, with derivative $U'_m$. Define

$$
F(q,z)=\frac{1}{U_{q-1}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{N+2}\right)U'_N\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{N+2}\right)}\sum_{j=1}^N U'_{N-j+1}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{N+2}\right)U_{jq-1}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{N+2}\right)z^j.
$$

**Parameterized univalence conjecture.** The polynomial $F(q,z)$ is univalent for every $q=1,\ldots,N$ and every positive integer $N$. The case $q=1$ recovers the preceding extremal polynomial conjecture; the source gives no resolution for the full parameter range.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.06927

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2018).
source_name: Dmitriy Dmitrishin, Andrey Smorodin and Alex Stokolos, “Estimating the Koebe radius for polynomials”, arXiv:1805.06927 (2018).
